protocol.month_selection: Four already archived phases: pandemic onset, high inflation, disinflation, recent period. Fixed before new Q2 simulations; not a project-level blind holdout.
protocol.comparison: Same exact base plus only observed previous-month Q2; no prescribed inflation effect.
protocol.decision_rule: No automatic upgrade. Report center and individual/distribution tradeoffs, coverage and per-month changes.
protocol.truth_isolation: Preparation reads only frozen P/E/prompt/links and validated Q2 cache, not current inflation answers.
limits: Four inspected months; exploratory, not new independent blind validation.
Previous real Q2 and prior Q8/Q9 are private A conditions, not strict public B inputs.
Two generations are API variability, not additional respondents. Mutable model alias remains.

auxiliary_survey_weighted.weight_definition: Parent SCE survey weight × parent-stratum size / selected-stratum size; descriptive sensitivity only.
Parent SCE survey weight × parent-stratum size / selected-stratum size; descriptive sensitivity only.

primary_view: auxiliary_survey_weighted: its survey_weight is frozen design-survey weight here.

paired_intervals.scope: Exploratory unadjusted paired person clusters, months/repeats kept together; not time-generalization intervals.

notes: No correction of invalid replies. Human scores are reused from frozen evaluation; new model vectors use the same scorer.
All-arm/both-repeat common support; macro and individual metrics are distinct; repeats are not extra people.
carry_scope: Only current mean-level/distribution/update comparisons; no newly invented Q9 density.
